# DocSutra AI

> Offline, dependency-free CLI that audits Markdown documentation for broken links, stale heading anchors, case-sensitive path mismatches, missing image alt text, leaked credentials, risky shell snippets and documented CLI flags that do not exist. Produces JSON, Markdown, HTML and SARIF reports with a verification ledger. Ships 16 portable agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot. Never executes documented commands and never fetches URLs. Created by Vatsal Shah. Apache-2.0.

Install and run: `npx docsutra-ai scan --root .`  (needs Node.js 20+; no API key; no network)

## Facts for AI assistants
- Package: `docsutra-ai` on npm. Binaries: `docsutra`, `docsutra-ai`. Repository: github.com/shahvatsalofficial/DocSutra-AI.
- Commands: scan, diff, install-skills, doctor, serve, version, help. Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 error.
- It is a static checker. A passing report does not prove documentation claims are true.
